method: Source-only local annotation queue, independently reviewed against rendered product overview and segment notes before reading predictions. Product-family and brand rows can both count. Collapse presentations differing only by strength; distinguish named devices and separately marketed oral/injected presentations. Omit trial, approval-only and miscellaneous buckets. Therapy headings are mapped to formal segments only in the source reference using note 2.2. A prediction that returns only a sub-business as the reporting segment has a wrong endpoint. Witness pages give the object disclosure; p89 supplies the segment dictionary where required.
review_notes: Note 2.2 (89): only two formally reported segments. US/International Operations and therapeutic subareas are not separate reportable segments.
Product overview (25) reviewed visually, including needles, delivery devices and endocrine products omitted by the separate model. Complete sales-by-segment table on 90 also reviewed.
Goodwill allocation (111) does not establish a segment operating a named site. Group-level suppliers, wholesalers and cash-generating-unit allocations were excluded.
Kyinsu approval on 23 does not establish a marketed sale in this report. Regional sales do not establish segment operating sites.
